title: Way More Recipes
description: just a bit more recipes than usual...
body:
> **_READ DESC FOR HOW TO USE_**

**Recommended to use with JEI, To get the recipes say /grantrecipes in chat. This mod only adds recipes. DON'T expect anything else.**

_Adds a few more recipes than usual.._

**For example: Spawn eggs! (who asked for these...) And of-course... CHAINMAIL! (why) And who could forget... Most unobtainable items! (WHAT!) Well uhh... to make Spawn Eggs you first kinda have to make the heads... But who cares about the smallest details! That's why people never read the fine print. Oh and also added some like silly game beating crafting recipes??? I guess...**

This mod adds: Recipes for food, Recipes for armor (not custom made), Recipes for unobtainables.
